steps.code:
# Let's get all habit tracker notes by paginating through all pages
all_notes = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page_notes = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, tags=['habit-tracker'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page_notes:
        break
    all_notes.extend(page_notes)
    if len(page_notes) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total notes found: {len(all_notes)}")
print(f"First note: {all_notes[0]['title']}")
print(f"Last note: {all_notes[-1]['title']}")

steps.code:
# Fetch all note contents and check ate_homemade_meals status
habit_dates = []
for note in all_notes:
    note_detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note['note_id'], access_token=access_token)
    content = note_detail['content']
    # Parse the ate_homemade_meals line
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('ate_homemade_meals:'):
            value = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            habit_dates.append((note['title'], value))
            break

print(habit_dates)
